cond_0001.intro: The Support Analyst will assist in monitoring, analyzing, and resolving data platforms, configuration, and infrastructure-related issues. This person serves as a liaison between technical and operation teams. This position provides analysis and problem solving, technical assistance, and support coordination to business stakeholders. The person will make decisions based on independent judgment to resolve a range of complete technical problems. The Support Analyst needs strong analytical skills and the ability to think outside the box when the root cause of an issue is not obvious or clearly defined, and a solutions-focused approach to resolving issues with improved processes.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Works and communicates directly with clients and management for any production events, escalating issues as needed while communicating status and risks and producing after outage documentation.
Act as a liaison between data operations, development, infrastructure and management. Coordinate and troubleshoot to resolve applications or product related issues.
Manage and coordinate meetings with required technical and data operations team members and prioritize and route the issues reported as per the impact on business.
Document and improve Production Support processes and add to knowledge base of system problems and resolutions for future reference, including peer knowledge sharing and training.
Help data operations team members to create incidents and change request tickets.
Interface with the engineering, infrastructure, database administrator, implementation, and configuration management teams to follow up on any outstanding tickets for resolving the issues.
Follow up for root cause analysis and confirm on permanent resolution status for an issue.
Generate and provide daily status updated report to required business stakeholders and leadership team.
Completes all responsibilities as outlined on annual Performance Plan.
Completes all special projects and other duties as assigned.
Must be able to perform duties with or without reasonable accommodation.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in computer science, information technology, or related technical field or equivalent
0-1 Year of experience developing/supporting enterprise-level applications software in multi-node Windows or Linux Server environments.
Knowledge of application architectures, workflows and monitoring tools.
0-1 Year of experience working with SQL, Oracle, PL/SQL, MS Access and DB Management tools, proficiency with PowerShell, Bash or VB scripting, plus Java EE and/or .NET frameworks.
Ability to work in a cross-functional global team environment, utilizing on-line collaboration tools.
Ability to troubleshoot application issues and escalate to supporting engineering teams.
Knowledge of commonly used information technology concepts, practices and procedures.
Solid written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to work independently and in a team environment.
Ability to handle multiple tasks, prioritize and meet deadlines.
Preferred Requirements
Bachelor's degree in computer science, information technology, or related technical field (vs. Equivalent experience)
Project management experience.
Previous Help Desk experience.
Experience working in an Agile environment.

The person will make decisions based on independent judgment to resolve a range of complete technical problems. The Support Analyst needs strong analytical skills and the ability to think outside the box when the root cause of an issue is not obvious or clearly defined, and a solutions-focused approach to resolving issues with improved processes. Most people become stronger in this work over time as they build experience troubleshooting and supporting complex technical environments.
cond_0041.responsibilities:
Works and communicates directly with clients and management for any production events, escalating issues as needed while communicating status and risks and producing after outage documentation.

Manage and coordinate meetings with required technical and data operations team members and prioritize and route the issues reported as per the impact on business.
Document and improve Production Support processes and add to knowledge base of system problems and resolutions for future reference, including peer knowledge sharing and training.
Help data operations team members to create incidents and change request tickets.
Interface with the engineering, infrastructure, database administrator, implementation, and configuration management teams to follow up on any outstanding tickets for resolving the issues.
Follow up for root cause analysis and confirm on permanent resolution status for an issue.
Generate and provide daily status updated report to required business stakeholders and leadership team.

The role involves hands-on problem solving, technical assistance, and active coordination with business stakeholders. You will make decisions based on independent judgment to resolve a range of complex technical problems, and you will need strong analytical skills and a solutions-focused approach when root causes are not immediately clear.

Work and communicate directly with clients and management during production events, escalating issues as needed, keeping stakeholders informed of status and risks, and producing post-outage documentation.
Serve as an active liaison between data operations, development, infrastructure, and management — regularly connecting with each group to coordinate and troubleshoot application or product issues.
Manage and lead meetings with the required technical and data operations team members; prioritize and route reported issues based on business impact.
Document and improve Production Support processes and contribute to the knowledge base of system problems and resolutions, including peer knowledge sharing and training.
Help data operations team members create incident and change request tickets.
Stay in regular contact with engineering, infrastructure, database administrator, implementation, and configuration management teams to follow up on outstanding tickets.
Follow up on root cause analysis and confirm permanent resolution status for issues.
Generate and deliver daily status update reports to business stakeholders and the leadership team.
Complete all responsibilities as outlined on the annual Performance Plan.
Complete all special projects and other duties as assigned.
Must be able to perform duties with or without reasonable accommodation.

Solid written and verbal communication skills

This person serves as a liaison between technical and operation teams. This position provides analysis and problem solving, technical assistance, and support coordination to business stakeholders. The person will make decisions based on independent judgment to resolve a range of complete technical problems. The Support Analyst needs strong analytical skills and the ability to think outside the box when the root cause of an issue is not obvious or clearly defined, and a solutions-focused approach to resolving issues with improved processes.

Manage and coordinate meetings with required technical and data operations team members and prioritize and route the issues reported as per the impact on business.
Document and improve Production Support processes and add to knowledge base of system problems and resolutions for future reference, including peer knowledge sharing and training.

Interface with the engineering, infrastructure, database administrator, implementation, and configuration management teams to follow up on any outstanding tickets for resolving the issues.
